column1: # Key K4b: cipher of the Spanish embassy at Genoa, 1643 (Juan de Eraso). A different table from the 1638 key (genes1638).
# Columns: token, value(s) (alternatives separated by |), source (EM = learned by seeded EM alignment on cipher/plain pairs,
# EM+corr = EM value checked by hand, S = structural fill from its series, K4b(15) = added from the pair 3598,15 / 14).
# K4 learned on AGS EST,LEG,3598,38 / 37 and 41 / 40 and frozen (SHA-256 0fe6538a...). K4b = K4 + five values from 15 / 14,
# frozen (SHA-256 b41108d8...) before the main held-out test 3598,291 p. 1 vs its plain copy 3598,290:
# 0.881 of characters / 0.834 of words; 200 permuted-value control keys p99 0.298 / 0.121.
# Transcription conventions: ℓ = loop sign (a); J = tall stroke (h); 1 = short stroke (g/h); tt = crossed tt (s); X̲ = underlined code.
